name: lcms2
description: Little CMS, a small-footprint color management engine providing fast transforms between ICC color profiles. Used by wlroots' Vulkan renderer for the color-management-v1 Wayland protocol (color range/encoding transforms).
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
